title: Design-system foundation: tokens, type scale, arena fixes and shared primitives
why: Every later package builds on these. It also fixes three site-wide problems judges see instantly: the arena grid and glows never render (an unlayered background shorthand resets background-image), keyboard focus is invisible on every button (clip-path cuts the outline), and the live, final-seconds and K.O. styles break the colour rules.
spec: GLOBALS.CSS. 1) On html, body replace `background: var(--color-void)` with `background-color: var(--color-void)` so the .arena background-image renders. Update the header comment: orange is the COOKED mark only (the stamp at any size); K.O. is ink; live is shown as both corners (split dot). 2) Add @theme tokens exactly: --color-panel-3 #1c1c29, --color-line-strong #34344f, --color-faint #5c5c74, --color-p1-tint #11232d, --color-p2-tint #261324, --color-up-tint #132924, --color-down-tint #2b161f; --shadow-glow-p1 0 0 24px rgb(47 224 255 / 0.35), --shadow-glow-p2 0 0 24px rgb(255 62 165 / 0.35), --shadow-glow-up 0 0 24px rgb(53 242 139 / 0.35), --shadow-overlay 0 16px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); text tokens with --line-height companions: micro 10px/12px, label 11px/14px, meta 12px/16px, num-lg 20px/24px, hud-xs 18px/18px, hud-sm 24px/24px, hud-lg 56px/50px, hud-xl 88px/75px, clock 48px/48px, hud-ko 128px/109px. Replace raw rgba values in .arena and .pulse-dot with color-mix of the tokens. 3) In @layer components add: .h-page (display face, 900, uppercase, 2rem, line-height 1; 2.5rem at min-width 1024px); .h-section (display, 1.5rem, line-height 1); .micro (mono, 10px, 0.12em tracking, uppercase); .num (mono, tabular-nums); .link (ink, underline, decoration-line, offset 4px, hover decoration ink); .row (panel background, hover panel-3, 120ms background transition); .plate-card (panel background, inset 1px line ring, clip-path polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 10px) 0, 100% 10px, 100% 100%, 0 100%)); .rope (position relative; ::before absolute top 0 inset-x 0 height 2px with a hard split gradient: p1 0 to 50%, p2 50% to 100%); .plate-win (up-tint background, up text, same notch as .plate-card, padding 0.25rem 0.5rem); .stamp-cooked-sm (stencil face, 900, uppercase, cooked colour, 2px cooked border, 11px, padding 0 0.3em, rotate -8deg, no animation); .live-dot (8px round, background linear-gradient(90deg, p1 50%, p2 50%), pulse ring in ink at 45% using the existing pulse keyframes rewritten with color-mix of ink) and make .pulse-dot an alias with identical rules; .bar-danger (repeating-linear-gradient 45deg of currentColor-based side colour and its -deep variant, 6px stripes, applied via a --side custom property); .skeleton (panel-2 background with a 1.4s linear infinite shimmer gradient towards panel-3); .flash-up and .flash-down (400ms ease-out background from up-tint or down-tint to transparent); .row-new (400ms background from color-mix(ink 6%) to transparent); .digit-roll (300ms from translateY(60%) opacity 0 to none); .tip-ping (600ms one-shot expanding ring via box-shadow); .toast-in (220ms from translateY(-8px) opacity 0); .sheet-in (240ms from translateY(100%)); .scroll-thin (scrollbar-width thin, scrollbar-color line transparent); .pb-safe (padding-bottom env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); :root { --bottom-nav-h: 0px } and .has-bottom-nav { --bottom-nav-h: 3.5rem } inside a max-width 639px media query. 4) Buttons: .btn-p1:hover:not(:disabled) and .btn-p2:hover:not(:disabled) filter brightness(1.1); .btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-void), inset 0 0 0 4px var(--color-ink) }; a generic :where(a, button, [role=tab], [tabindex], summary):focus-visible outline 2px solid ink, outline-offset 2px (the .btn rule must still win on buttons); .input:focus ring becomes ink. 5) .final-seconds colour becomes ink (keep the blink). .ko: remove the orange glow; text-shadow -3px 0 0 var(--color-p1), 3px 0 0 var(--color-p2), 0 6px 0 var(--color-void). 6) Extend the prefers-reduced-motion block with .live-dot, .skeleton, .flash-up, .flash-down, .row-new, .digit-roll, .tip-ping, .toast-in, .sheet-in set to animation none. PRIMITIVES in src/components/ui (client components where they use hooks; no new npm dependencies; no hex literals, only token classes or var(--color-*)): cx.ts: tiny class joiner. Plate({as, notch, rope, pad: 'none'|'dense'|'std'|'arena', className, children}) where dense is px-3 py-2.5, std p-4, arena p-5 sm:p-8; without notch it uses the existing .card look. PageHeader({eyebrow, title, stats?, action?}) with .label eyebrow, h1.h-page, flex-wrap row, py-6. SectionHead({title, count?, action?: {href, label}}) with h2.h-section, micro count, label link. StatStrip({cells: {label, value, sub?, href?}[], cols?: {base, sm, lg}}) as a dl grid with 1px line gaps (bg-line gap-px), cells bg-panel dense padding, label as .label and value as display hud-sm ink; compute a col-span class for the last cell at each breakpoint so no empty cell ever shows. Versus({left, center, right, stackBelow?: 'sm'|'md'}) grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto_minmax(0,1fr)] with min-w-0 children, stacking into one column below the breakpoint. Badge({variant: 'neutral'|'source'|'live'|'count'|'win'|'cooked', children}) at .micro, 18px tall, px-1.5: neutral ring-1 ring-line text-ink, source ring-1 ring-line text-dim, live LiveDot plus ink text, count bg-panel-3 text-ink, win bg-up-tint text-up, cooked .stamp-cooked-sm. LiveDot renders span.live-dot aria-hidden. Skeleton({className}) and SkeletonRows({kind: 'fight'|'quote'|'fighter'|'event', rows}) with heights 64px for fight and 36px for the rest, container aria-busy with an sr-only 'Loading'. Notice({tone: 'info'|'warn'|'error', title, children?, action?}) panel-2 plate, left rule 2px (error ink, warn dashed line-strong, info line), 16px glyph square in ink with i, ! or x, ink text, never red or orange. Empty({title, body?, action?}) centered inside a Plate with h-section title. Tabs({items: {id, label, count?}[], value, onChange, ariaLabel}) as slanted segment plates (clip-path like .btn, btn-light when selected, btn-ghost otherwise), role tablist, aria-selected, roving tabindex with arrow keys and Home and End; plus useUrlTab(param, ids, fallback) using useSearchParams and router.replace with scroll false (callers must wrap pages in Suspense). Sparkline({values: (number|null)[], width=64, height=20, tone: 'move'|'p1'|'p2'|'ink', label}) SVG polyline stroke 1.5 with vector-effect non-scaling-stroke and a 2px dot on the last point; tone move uses up when last >= first else down; nulls skipped; fewer than 2 points draws a faint horizontal dash; role img with aria-label. Identicon({wallet, size=20}) FNV-1a 32-bit hash of the base58 string seeding xorshift32 to fill 15 bits of a 5x5 mirrored grid; on cells ink at 90%, background panel-2, wrapped in a .plate slant; aria-hidden. FighterName({wallet, href?: string|null, size: 'sm'|'md'|'lg', avatar=true, you?}) reads useProfiles() from lib/hooks for the handle: '@handle' in ink sans semibold when present, else shortAddress(wallet) (4...4) in mono dim; default href `/u/${wallet}`, null renders no link; title attribute is the full address; truncates; you shows a neutral Badge 'You'. FormPips({results: ('W'|'L'|'T')[], max=10}) 6px squares with gap 2px: W bg-up, L ring-1 ring-faint, T a dim 2px bar; aria-label like '7 wins, 3 losses in the last 10'. FlashNum({value: number|null, mode: 'price'|'count', children, className}) keeps the previous value in a ref and applies .flash-up, .flash-down or .row-new for 400ms keyed by change, tabular nums. Countdown({to, now?, finalSecs=10, size: 'clock'|'num'}) uses useNow when now is absent, renders clock() output with each digit in a fixed-width span re-keyed on change for .digit-roll, adds .final-seconds under finalSecs, role timer, and a visually hidden aria-live polite text updated at most every 10 seconds. Toast.tsx: a module-level store read with useSyncExternalStore; export toast.push({title, body?, tone?: 'neutral'|'win'|'cooked', href?, hrefLabel?, ttlMs=6000}) returning an id, toast.update(id, patch), toast.dismiss(id); pushing works with no Toaster mounted. Export Toaster rendering at most 3, newest first, in a portal: fixed top-4 centered at 640px and up, fixed bottom calc(var(--bottom-nav-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 0.75rem) on phones; panel-2 with line-strong ring and shadow-overlay; tone win adds a 2px up left rule and up title; tone cooked shows a .stamp-cooked-sm 'Cooked' before the title; close button; hover pauses the timer; Escape dismisses the newest; container role status aria-live polite; .toast-in. TxButton({run: (onSent: (sig: string) => void) => Promise<string|string[]|void>, label, successTitle, className, disabled}) with states idle, signing (until onSent), confirming (after onSent, shows an ExplorerLink for the signature), done (2.5s then idle), error (inline Notice using readableProgramError from lib/duel); on done it pushes a toast with successTitle, body 'Confirmed in 1.4s' measured from onSent to resolve, and an explorer link built with explorerTx(sig, CLUSTER); aria-busy while pending. Sheet({open, onClose, title, children}) in a portal: bottom sheet with .sheet-in below 640px, centered panel at 640px and up; void/70 backdrop; focus trap; Escape and backdrop close; body scroll lock; role dialog aria-modal. Menu({trigger, children, align}) and MenuItem: portal popover positioned from the trigger rect, aria-haspopup and aria-expanded, outside click and Escape close, arrow keys between items, focus returns to the trigger. Tip({label, children}) opens on hover, focus or tap, role tooltip, aria-describedby, portal. ExplorerLink({kind: 'tx'|'address', value, label?}) uses explorerTx and explorerAddress from lib/hooks and CLUSTER from lib/stocks, shows a shortened value plus an arrow glyph, target _blank rel noreferrer. Kbd({children}) micro chip with a line ring. intents.ts: export CONNECT_EVENT = 'stonk:connect'; requestConnect() dispatches a window CustomEvent; WATCH_KEY = 'stonk:watched'; watchFight(address) stores up to 30 unique addresses newest first in localStorage inside try/catch; watchedFights() returns them or []; SOUND_KEY = 'stonk:sound'. No page imports these primitives yet, which is expected.
acceptance: npm run build and npm run test:web both pass.
git diff --name-only lists only src/app/globals.css and files under src/components/ui/.
In a browser, getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundImage is not 'none' on / and shows the grid and the cyan and pink glows.
Tabbing to any .btn shows a visible ink ring; .btn-p1 and .btn-p2 brighten on hover.
.pulse-dot and .live-dot render as a split cyan and pink dot, not green.
.final-seconds text is ink and .ko has no orange glow.
No six-digit hex literal appears in any file under src/components/ui/.
With prefers-reduced-motion set to reduce, none of the new animation classes animate.
toast.push called with no Toaster mounted does not throw.

title: Honest live prices out of hours, 1-minute bars route, receipt relay method
why: Outside regular hours the site shows Yahoo regular-session prices, while 24/7 fights start and settle on perp or extended-hours 1-minute bars. Measured Sunday 13 Sep, 8:30pm ET: NVDA shown at 218.29 while the settling perp was at 214.50. Live moves carry a constant false offset, no hits land, and the bell can contradict the screen. The race chart and stock charts also need a bars route, and the fight receipt needs one more RPC method.
spec: 1) New pure module src/lib/livePrice.ts (no server-only import, no fetch): export type LiveSource = 'pyth'|'regular'|'extended'|'perp'|'last'. export liveSourceFor(stock: Stock, nowSec: number): LiveSource: stock.source === 'pyth' gives 'pyth'; stock.market !== 'US' gives 'regular'; session(nowSec*1000) 'open' gives 'regular'; 'pre' or 'after' gives 'extended'; 'closed' gives 'perp' when pricedAt(stock.ticker, nowSec) === 'perp', otherwise 'last' (pool-only stocks keep the last exchange price, because GeckoTerminal rate-limits live reads). export parseAllMids(body: unknown): Record<string, number> keeping only positive finite numbers. export lastClose(bars: Bars): {price: number, time: number} | null returning the last non-null positive close and its bar end (t + 60). export mergeBars(exchange: Bars, perp: Bars, isClosed: (t: number) => boolean): {t: number[], c: number[], src: ('exchange'|'perp')[]} taking exchange bars for minutes where isClosed is false and perp bars where it is true, ascending, nulls dropped, one point per minute. 2) src/lib/marketPrices.server.ts liveQuotes: group requested stocks by liveSourceFor(stock, now). 'pyth': unchanged pythQuotes path with market fallback. 'regular' and 'last': the existing marketQuotes path, tagging source accordingly. 'extended': fetchBars(stock.quote, now - 900, now) per stock with at most 6 concurrent requests, price from lastClose, publishTime its bar end, prev taken from the spark result so day change is still measured against the last regular close; on failure fall back to the marketQuotes value tagged 'last'. 'perp': one POST to https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info per distinct dex with body {type: 'allMids', dex} where dex is the text before ':' in quoteSymbolFor(stock.feed).perp (omit dex when the coin has no prefix); read the mid for the full coin name with parseAllMids; publishTime now; prev from spark; for any coin missing from the response fall back to lastClose(fetchPerpBars(coin, now - 300, now)); if both fail use the marketQuotes value tagged 'last'. Foreign-currency listings keep the current path. Log nothing sensitive. Do not modify pythQuotes, src/lib/oracle.ts, src/lib/crank.ts, src/lib/crankTx.ts or src/lib/pythCrank.ts: Monday's live Pyth test must see identical behaviour. 3) src/lib/pricemath.ts: add optional source?: LiveSource (import the type from livePrice.ts, or redeclare the same union) to Quote, and export sourceWords(source) returning 'Pyth', 'Exchange', 'Extended hours', 'Perp' or 'Last close'. Change nothing else in the file. 4) New src/app/api/bars/route.ts, GET ?t=TICKER&from=UNIX&to=UNIX, dynamic force-dynamic, maxDuration 30. Validate: byTicker exists and market is 'US' (otherwise 422 {error: 'Only US listings chart here'}); to > from; to - from <= 21600 (6 hours) else 400; from >= now - 29 days else 400; clamp to to now. Build isClosed = (t) => session(t*1000) === 'closed'. Fetch fetchBars(stock.quote, from, to) when any minute in range is not closed, and fetchPerpBars(coin, from, to) when any minute is closed and the stock has a perp (quoteSymbolFor). Respond {t, c, src, note?} from mergeBars; when closed minutes have no perp, set note 'No minute bars while the exchange is shut for this stock.' Keep an in-memory map of up to 200 finished ranges (to < now - 120). Cache-Control public, s-maxage=20 for ranges touching the last 2 minutes, else s-maxage=86400. Errors return 502 {error: short message} with no stack. Put a header comment stating these bars are for display only and never an input to any result. 5) src/app/api/rpc/route.ts: add 'getSignaturesForAddress' to ALLOWED with a one-line comment that the fight receipt reads it. 6) tests-web/livePrice.test.ts (mocha plus chai, same style as tests-web/market.test.ts, timestamps built with nyToMs): liveSourceFor for a Pyth stock; a US stock with a perp (pick one from src/data/perps.json) on Sunday 13 Sep 2026 20:30 ET gives 'perp', Tuesday 15 Sep 18:00 ET gives 'extended', Tuesday 11:00 ET gives 'regular'; a US stock present in src/data/pools.json but not perps.json on Sunday gives 'last'; a non-US listing gives 'regular'; parseAllMids on a fixture drops non-numeric values; lastClose skips trailing nulls; mergeBars takes exchange minutes in session and perp minutes when closed.
acceptance: npm run test:web passes, including tests-web/livePrice.test.ts.
npm run build passes.
With the exchange closed, GET /api/prices?t=NVDA returns quotes.NVDA.source 'perp' and a price within 0.5% of Hyperliquid's mid for that coin (checked once by hand).
During regular hours, /api/prices returns the same shape as before plus source 'regular' or 'pyth'.
GET /api/bars?t=NVDA&from=<now-3600>&to=<now> returns ascending t with a src value for every point; a 7-hour range returns 400; an unknown ticker returns an error, never a stack trace.
git diff shows no change to pythQuotes, oracle.ts, crank.ts, crankTx.ts or pythCrank.ts.
A JSON-RPC getSignaturesForAddress call through /api/rpc is forwarded instead of refused.

title: The record: derive layer, fighter profiles and a leaderboard ranked by money
why: Judges ask whether real people use this. Today every fighter is a wallet address, the leaderboard is sorted by wins (so $5.49 ranks #2), $0.00 rows show in green, and nothing links anywhere. One pure derive layer over the existing duel list powers profiles, the Wire, toasts, stock records and the home page. Profiles must exist before later packages link handles to /u.
spec: 1) src/lib/format.ts, additions only (keep existing exports and behaviour): ago(unix, now) giving 'now' under 10s, '45s ago', '12m ago', '3h ago', '2d ago' up to 6 days, then 'Sep 3' style in ET; until(unix, now) giving 'in 45s', 'in 12m', 'in 3h', 'in 6d'; etWhen(startUnix, endUnix) giving 'Sat 12 Sep, 4:21 to 4:27 PM ET' when both are the same ET day and 'Fri 11 Sep 3:00 PM to Mon 14 Sep 9:30 AM ET' otherwise. No em or en dashes in any output. Add cases to tests-web/format.test.ts. 2) New pure src/lib/derive.ts (no React; imports duel constants, stocks and format only): isRosterFight(d) is true when both mints resolve through tickerForMint to tickers found by byTicker. loserTake(d) returns {shares raw bigint, ticker, usd} for a settled fight: the loser's stake valued at the loser's on-chain end price. margin(d) returns absolute percentage points between the two on-chain moves (movePct on start and end) or null. fightEvents(duels, now, {rosterOnly = true}) returns newest-first events {id: address + ':' + kind, kind: 'opened'|'taken'|'live'|'bell'|'heat'|'void'|'expired', at, address, creator, opponent, invitee, t1, t2, taunt, winnerSide?: 'p1'|'p2', margin?, take?}: opened at createdTs; taken at acceptedTs when acceptedTs > 0; live at startTs when startTs > 0; bell at endTs for SETTLED; heat at endTs for REFUNDED with outcome TIE; void for VOID at max(acceptedTs, endTs); expired at expiresTs for OPEN with expiresTs <= now. Add a comment that cancelled fights close their account and cannot appear. recordFor(wallet, duels) returns {wins, losses, ties, taken, lost, streak, best, form (last 10 of W, L, T oldest first), fights, lastTs} over all settled and tied fights on chain. tickerRecord(ticker, duels) returns {fights, wins, losses, ties, open} over roster fights where the ticker was either side (a win means that side won). headToHead(wallet, duels) returns the top 5 opponents by fights with W-L. records(duels) returns {closest: {address, margin} | null (smallest non-zero margin among settled), biggestMove: {address, ticker, move} | null (largest absolute winning move), longestStreak: {wallet, best} | null}. lastBell(duels) returns the latest endTs among settled or tied fights, or 0. calledOut(wallet, duels, now) returns OPEN, unexpired fights whose invitee equals wallet. inWindow(duels, secs, now) keeps fights with endTs >= now - secs. 3) src/lib/leaderboard.ts: rankFighters sorts by taken desc, then wins desc, then losses asc. Record_ gains lost (dollars of own stake lost, at own end price), form (last 10 results), winRate, lastTs. tallyOf keeps its signature and meaning. Records keep counting every settled fight on chain. 4) tests-web/derive.test.ts: a makeDuel(partial) fixture helper built with PublicKey.unique() and real devnet test mints read from tickers in src/data/stocks.devnet.json. Cover: event kinds and newest-first order; recordFor streak, best and form; the new rankFighters order; isRosterFight false for an ETHt mint; calledOut; records.closest ignores exact ties; inWindow. 5) src/app/u/[wallet]/page.tsx: server component. Invalid PublicKey calls notFound(). generateMetadata reads the Profile PDA (profilePda plus decodeProfile, with a 2 second race like src/app/f/[duel]/page.tsx) for the title '@handle' or the short address. Renders Suspense with a SkeletonRows fallback around ProfileView. 6) ProfileView (client): useDuels('all', allDuels()), useProfiles, useWallet, useNow. Header Plate notch: Identicon size 48, FighterName lg with href null, a copy-address button (toast 'Address copied'), ExplorerLink address, Badge 'You' when it is the connected wallet. Actions: 'Challenge this fighter' btn-p1 linking /new?invite=WALLET (hidden for self); ConnectX compact when self and no handle. StatStrip: Record ('4W 1L', with the L part dim), Win rate, Streak (current), Best streak, Taken (text-up when > 0), Lost (ink), Fights. FormPips of the last 10. lg grid 8fr and 4fr. Left: SectionHead 'History' with FightRow list newest first, roster fights only, plus a text toggle 'Show N test-token fights' when N > 0. Right rail: 'Favourite stocks' (top 5 tickers this wallet fought with, tickerRecord style W-L for this wallet only), 'Rivals' (headToHead with FighterName sm), 'Open challenges' by this wallet. States: Skeleton while loading; Notice error with Retry calling refetch; Empty 'No fights on chain for this wallet yet.' with a Pick a fight action. 7) src/app/u/[wallet]/opengraph-image.tsx: 1200x630 using lib/palette.ts colours and lib/ogFont.ts. Server reads duels with duelsCreatedBy and duelsAcceptedBy through new Connection(process.env.RPC_URL || NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL || devnet), each raced against 3 seconds. Draws identicon cells, handle or short address, W-L, taken and last-10 pips. Any failure returns the site card (render the default export of src/app/opengraph-image.tsx, or a minimal brand card inline), never a 500 or stack trace. 8) src/app/leaderboard/Leaderboard.tsx: PageHeader (eyebrow 'Settled on chain', title 'Leaderboard', stats: settled fights, wallets with a result, total taken). Tabs All, 7D, 24h via useUrlTab('range'); a range tab appears only when inWindow has at least one settled fight; default All. Records strip (StatStrip, 3 cells, each linking): 'Closest finish' margin in points linking the fight; 'Biggest winning move' ticker and pct linking the fight; 'Longest streak' FighterName and count. Podium at 640px and up: ranks 1 to 3 as Plate notch cards with rank in an ink .plate on panel-3, FighterName md, taken num-lg text-up, W-L and FormPips; on phones the podium is the first three rows. Rows from rank 4, each whole row linking /u/WALLET: rank ink, FighterName, FormPips, W-L (L dim), win rate, Badge neutral '3 in a row' when streak >= 2, taken right-aligned (text-up when > 0, else dim '$0.00'). Collapse every fighter with 0 wins into one expandable row '+N fighters with no wins yet'. Pinned 'You' row at the top when connected (their rank, or 'You: no settled fights yet'). Phones: two-line rows with taken always visible and no horizontal scroll. Skeleton rows while loading, Notice error with Retry. ConnectX compact sits under the board. 9) src/app/leaderboard/page.tsx wraps Leaderboard in Suspense with a skeleton fallback. 10) src/components/ConnectX.tsx: restyle only; do not change OAuth, attest or on-chain link logic. Handles in ink; buttons btn-light or btn-ghost (no btn-p1); success shows an inline ink Notice and also calls toast.push; errors as Notice; loading as Skeleton. Add a compact prop that renders a one-line version.
acceptance: npm run test:web passes with derive and format tests; npm run build passes.
/u/<a wallet from the live leaderboard> shows the same W-L and taken as /leaderboard; /u/not-a-key returns the 404 page.
The leaderboard is ordered by taken; $0.00 is dim, not green; ranks are ink, not cyan; L is dim, not red; 0-win fighters are collapsed into one row.
Every leaderboard row and podium card links to /u/WALLET, and a linked X handle shows instead of the address.
Refreshing /leaderboard?range=7d keeps the 7D tab when that range has fights.
At 375px wide, neither /leaderboard nor /u/WALLET scrolls horizontally, and Taken is visible.
GET /u/WALLET/opengraph-image returns an image with status 200 for a valid wallet, including when the RPC is unreachable.

title: App shell: toasts, fight watcher, wallet menu, command palette, bottom bar, 404 and error pages
why: This is what makes it feel like a real app on every page. Toasts need a mount point, phones need a thumb-reach nav, clicking a connected wallet currently disconnects instantly, market status uses green, and a bad link gets Next's default page. Toasts for your own fights (taken, live, won, cooked, called out) are the most fomo-like live feature, and they come from the duel list the app already polls.
spec: 1) src/app/layout.tsx: main becomes mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 with padding-bottom calc(var(--bottom-nav-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 1rem). Body classes 'arena has-bottom-nav min-h-dvh antialiased'. Inside Providers, mount SiteNav, main, SiteFooter, then Toaster (ui/Toast), FightWatcher, CommandPalette and BottomNav. Keep fonts and metadata unchanged. 2) SiteNav: container max-w-7xl. Desktop links Fights, Leaderboard, How it works; the current page gets ink text plus a 2px slanted ink underline plate and aria-current='page'. A search button with a magnifier glyph, 'Search' and Kbd '/', which opens the palette through a window CustomEvent 'stonk:palette'. Then MarketBadge, FaucetButton (test clusters), a 'Pick a fight' btn-sm btn-p1, and WalletButton. Remove the second mobile nav row; on phones the header shows the wordmark, a search icon button and WalletButton only. 3) New BottomNav: rendered below 640px only; fixed bottom-0, z-30, bg-panel-2, border-t line, .pb-safe, height 3.5rem. Items: Board (/), Fights (/fights) with a Badge count of derive.calledOut(me, duels, now) when that count is > 0, a center 'Pick a fight' slanted btn-p1 plate to /new, Ranks (/leaderboard), and Me (/u/WALLET when connected, otherwise a button calling requestConnect()). aria-current on the active item. useDuels runs only while a wallet is connected (pass null filters otherwise). 4) MarketBadge: open shows LiveDot plus 'Market open' in ink; pre and after show 'Pre-market' or 'After hours' in ink; closed shows 'Exchange shut' in dim plus a neutral Badge `${AROUND_THE_CLOCK} fight 24/7`. No green anywhere. 5) WalletButton: keep the HYDRATION, SELECT THEN CONNECT and PHONES logic exactly as the file header describes. Listen for CONNECT_EVENT from ui/intents and open the picker (or connect directly when exactly one wallet is installed). The mobile universal-link panel becomes a ui/Sheet. When connected, clicking opens a ui/Menu instead of disconnecting. Menu contents: header with Identicon and FighterName (links /u/WALLET); wallet name, with a neutral Badge 'Guest · devnet' for the guest wallet; SOL balance from connection.getBalance (refetch every 20s, only while the menu is open); share holdings from getTokenAccountsByOwner for both TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID and TOKEN_2022_PROGRAM_ID (only while open), mapped with tokenForMint, up to 8 non-zero rows showing ticker, shares and live value via usePrices; items My profile, My fights (/fights?tab=mine), Get test shares (FaucetButton on test clusters), Copy address (toast 'Address copied'), View on explorer (ExplorerLink), Disconnect. Disconnect needs a second click within 3 seconds, with the label changing to 'Click again to disconnect'. Error popovers become an ink Notice inside the menu or picker. Escape and outside click close; aria-expanded on the trigger. 6) FaucetButton: keep the /api/faucet call. Add a primary?: boolean prop (btn-light instead of btn-ghost, normal size instead of btn-sm). Replace the absolute-positioned message card with toast.push: success in neutral tone titled with the server's message (fallback 'Test shares sent.'), failure as a neutral toast with the error text. Busy label 'Minting...'. No text-up or text-down. 7) New CommandPalette: opens on '/', Ctrl+K or Cmd+K when focus is not in an input, textarea or contenteditable, and on the 'stonk:palette' event. Uses ui/Sheet on phones and a centered overlay panel at 640px and up. One input with role combobox and a listbox of results, arrow keys, Enter, Escape. Sections: Stocks (match ticker prefix first, then name substring; top 8; Enter goes to /new?p1=TICKER; a secondary 'Against' action goes to /new?p2=TICKER); Fighters (handles fuzzy-matched from useProfiles plus wallets from the duel list whose base58 starts with the query; go to /u/WALLET); Fights (open and live roster fights where either ticker matches; go to /f/ADDRESS); Paste (when the query parses as a PublicKey: /f/ADDRESS if it is a loaded duel address, else /u/ADDRESS). With an empty query, show up to 5 live and open fights. 8) New pure src/lib/watcher.ts: diffFights(prev: DuelView[], next: DuelView[], me: string | null, watched: string[], now) returns notices {id, title, tone, href} for duels whose status changed and that involve me or are in watched: OPEN to ACCEPTED for the creator gives 'Your NVDA challenge was taken.'; to LIVE gives 'Round live: NVDA vs AAPL.'; to SETTLED gives, for the winner, 'Bell. You took 0.11 AAPLx.' (tone win, shares from derive.loserTake), for the loser, 'Cooked. AAPL beat NVDA by 0.29 percentage points. Run it back?' (tone cooked), and for a watcher who did not fight, 'NVDA vs AAPL is final.'; to REFUNDED with a tie gives 'Dead heat. Both stakes home.' Tickers come from tickerForMint with '?' fallback. tests-web/watcher.test.ts covers every transition, the first-load silence and non-involved duels. 9) New FightWatcher (renders null): enabled when a wallet is connected or watchedFights() is non-empty. title: The fight screen: price to beat, race chart, a K.O. that reads, receipt and share
why:
This is the money shot for the demo video and the clearest answer to 'why Solana'. Today:
- The COOKED stamp covers the loser's ticker, both health bars are full at K.O., and the winner's number is red.
- Times are ISO strings and there is no chart.
- An RPC error says 'No fight here'.
- Open and waiting states are mostly empty.

The fix shows the two on-chain start prices, the path, the bell, who signed each step with explorer links, and a share card.
spec:
1) STATES. FightView: an invalid key renders Empty 'That is not a fight address.'. Loading renders an arena-shaped Skeleton. duel.error renders Notice error 'Could not reach Solana. Retrying every few seconds.' with a Retry calling refetch, and never the no-fight copy. data === null renders Empty 'No fight at this address.' with body 'Cancelled fights close their account, so their links stop working.' and a Pick a fight action. On mount call watchFight(address) from ui/intents. page.tsx: the Suspense fallback is the same arena skeleton. Keep generateMetadata. 2) LAYOUT. Status strip: LiveDot plus 'Live' for live rounds, state words otherwise (ink or dim, never green), SoundToggle, and an 'All fights' link. Arena: Plate notch rope pad arena containing Versus(Corner p1, center, Corner p2). Below the arena at lg, a grid of minmax(0,8fr) (RaceChart then Receipt) and minmax(0,4fr) (Actions sticky top-20, then TaleOfTheTape for open challenges, then ShareFight). On phones stack arena, Actions, RaceChart, ShareFight, Receipt. 3) Corner.tsx: role label ('Challenger', 'Answered', 'Open seat', or 'For ' plus FighterName sm when invite-only). Ticker in .display with text-hud-xl at 640px and up and 64px below, in the side colour; the loser's ticker is at 50% opacity and is never covered. Stock name meta dim. FighterName md with derive.recordFor W-L as a micro dim suffix (useDuels('all', allDuels())). Stake line in .num: shares plus token symbol in normal-case, then ' · $25.00'. PriceToBeat. Winner: .plate-win 'Took 0.0100 METAx · $6.48' from derive.loserTake, with a meta line 'plus their own stake back'. Loser: the existing .stamp-cooked positioned over the stake-and-move block on the side away from centre, text-4xl, never over the ticker. During a live round the leading corner gets shadow-glow-p1 or shadow-glow-p2. 4) PriceToBeat.tsx: live and settled show 'Start' (on-chain start via pythToNumber, with etTime) and 'Now' (live quote in FlashNum price mode plus a Badge source using sourceWords(quote.source)) or 'Bell' (on-chain end price), then the % since start using Move at num-lg. An open challenge shows 'Now' and the day change. An accepted fight waiting for the market shows 'Start price posts when its market opens.'. 5) Centre column: live shows HealthBars, Countdown to endTs at clock size, 'to the bell · ' plus etTime(endTs), Combo, and 'NVDA leads by 0.12 percentage points' or 'Dead even'. Open shows VS, the round length or 'Ends at the first price after 4:00 PM ET', and 'Closes in' plus a Countdown to expiresTs. Accepted and waitingForMarket (imported from components/FightRow) shows 'Prices from' plus a Countdown to fightClock.pricesFrom(d, now) and the ET time. Settled shows HealthBars with ko set to the loser, 'Won by 0.0062 percentage points' via points(), then etWhen(startTs, endTs) and span(endTs - startTs) + ' round'. A tie shows 'Dead heat. Both stakes home.'. 6) New pure src/lib/fightClock.ts: pricesFrom(d, nowSec) returns the first unix time at or after now, stepping in 15-minute increments for up to 5 days, where neither side's pricedAt(ticker, t) is 'waits', or 0 if none. Tests in tests-web/fightClock.test.ts: Saturday gives a Monday pre-market time for an oracle-priced stock without a perp, and 0 steps for a 24/7 pair. 7) HealthBars: remove the red low state; below 30 health the fill gets .bar-danger in its side colour. Add an optional prop ko?: 'p1'|'p2'|null that forces that side to 0. src/lib/health.ts: add settledHealth(p1Move, p2Move, outcome, roundSecs) returning [h1, h2] with the loser at 0 and the winner at max(healthFor result, 10), ties unchanged. tests-web/koHealth.test.ts covers both outcomes and a tie. Do not edit tests-web/prices.test.ts. 8) FightFx: Knockout renders 'K.O.' in text-ink with the .ko class, and 'Draw' in ink. Damage stays text-down. Combo keeps side colours. 9) RaceChart.tsx (plain SVG, no chart library): x from startTs to endTs (live: to max(now, startTs + 60)); y is percent from each side's on-chain start, with a domain symmetric around 0 plus 10% headroom. Dashed zero line in line-strong labelled 'Start'. P1 line in p1 and P2 line in p2, stroke 2. A dot at each tip with .tip-ping when a point is added. Right-edge labels 'NVDA +0.42%' in side colours. A dashed bell marker at endTs. The area between the lines filled at 8% of the leading side's colour. Pointer and touch crosshair showing ET time and both values. Caption in meta dim: 'Path from 1-minute market bars and live prices, for watching. The result uses only the on-chain start and bell prices.' useRaceSeries(duel, quotes): for rounds of at least 5 minutes, GET /api/bars per roster ticker from max(startTs, min(now, endTs) - 21600) to min(now, endTs). While live, append each usePrices quote (dedupe by publishTime). Persist live points in sessionStorage per duel inside try/catch. For settled fights, pin the first point to the on-chain start and the last to the on-chain end. Pure helpers in src/lib/raceSeries.ts (toPercentSeries, mergePoints, pinEndpoints) with tests in tests-web/raceSeries.test.ts. With no bars and no polls (a short round seen afterwards, a test-token fight, a pool-only stock off hours, or data older than 29 days), draw only the two on-chain endpoints joined by a dashed segment with the note 'Too short for minute bars. Start and bell prices only.'. For rounds longer than 6 hours add 'Showing the last 6 hours.'. Hidden before the start. 10) Actions.tsx: take, cancel and refund use ui/TxButton wrapping the existing builders and useSend (pass onSent through). The crank buttons keep crankFromBrowser inside TxButton. The primary action is the next step: not connected gives 'Connect to take it' calling requestConnect(); connected with a short balance on a test cluster gives FaucetButton primary labelled 'Get test ' + tokenSymbol; ready gives 'Take it · stake 0.1145 HOODx' in btn-p2. Show 'Lock the start prices yourself' only when startDue and not waitingForMarket(d, now). On phones, an open challenge the viewer can take shows a sticky bar fixed at bottom calc(var(--bottom-nav-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), bg-panel-2 with rope, 'HOOD vs AMZN · $25 a side' and the primary action, and the page reserves that height. Run it back: when the viewer fought, the link adds &invite=OTHER_WALLET and reads 'Run it back vs @handle · $26 a side' (handle or short address); otherwise keep the existing copy. Hints become Notice info; errors become Notice error; no text-up or text-down paragraphs. 11) Receipt.tsx plus src/lib/useReceipt.ts plus src/lib/receipt.ts: useReceipt calls connection.getSignaturesForAddress(duel, {limit: 25}), then getTransaction for up to 10 signatures (maxSupportedTransactionVersion 0, commitment confirmed). Refetch every 15s until settled or refunded, then staleTime Infinity. receipt.ts classifyTx(tx) decodes every log line starting 'Program data: ' with coder.events.decode (from lib/duel) into DuelCreated, DuelAccepted, DuelStarted, DuelSettled, DuelRefunded, DuelVoided or DuelCancelled, and returns {kind, blockTime, feePayer (first account key), signature, data}. tests-web/receipt.test.ts uses a fixture log line built by encoding an event with the same coder. Timeline rows: Called (creator), Taken (opponent), Start prices posted (fee payer, both start prices), Settled (fee payer, outcome, plus a Badge neutral 'settled by a spectator' when the fee payer is neither fighter), Refunded or Voided. Each row: ET time and ago(), FighterName sm for the signer, ExplorerLink tx. If no signatures come back, build rows from on-chain timestamps only and show Notice info 'This RPC node keeps no transaction history for this account.'. Below the timeline, restyle the price proof: side ticker, Start and Bell prices, 'Sat 12 Sep 4:21:00 PM ET' with the ISO string in the title attribute, the source ('Pyth' or the existing oracleRead result), and the feed id shortened with a copy button. Move the explanatory paragraph into a details element 'How these prices were chosen'. Keep the duel account ExplorerLink. 12) ShareFight.tsx: settled uses label 'Post the K.O.', an img preview of /f/ADDRESS/opengraph-image scaled into the card, 'Post on X' (the existing intent text, adding '@handle' for the winner when linked) and 'Copy link' (toast 'Link copied'). Open uses 'Send it to someone', with an ink ring when ?new=1. Live uses 'Share the fight'. Remove the raw URL input. 13) opengraph-image.tsx: the settled variant shows the winner ticker in its side colour, 'TOOK 0.0100 METAx' in green, both % moves, and the loser with the COOKED stamp. The catch branch returns the site card image (default export of src/app/opengraph-image.tsx, or a minimal brand card) with status 200; never a stack trace. 14) Tab title: set document.title to 'NVDA +0.42% vs AAPL -0.10% · 4:12' while live, 'NVDA vs AAPL · Final' when settled, 'NVDA vs AAPL · Open' when open; restore the previous title on unmount. 15) src/lib/sfx.ts: WebAudio synthesis only (no files); cues bell, lead change, tick, ko; a lazily created AudioContext resumed on the first user gesture. SoundToggle: aria-pressed, off by default, persisted under SOUND_KEY in localStorage inside try/catch. Cues fire only on real transitions seen while the page is open: status becomes LIVE; the sign of m1 - m2 flips between two real quotes; each second under 10 left; SETTLED while watching.

AFTER THE SETTLER AND HOURS FIXES (added 14 Sep, overrides anything above that conflicts). Main now carries, live and verified in production: src/lib/priceClock.ts (readyAt(d, which, now): when a side's price can exist, or { shut } while its market is closed; MANUAL_FALLBACK_SECS = 180), src/lib/roundClock.ts (roundClock(d, now, nudge) returning { line, secondsLeft, manual }, and shutSides(d, now)), src/lib/useSettlerNudge.ts (useDuel in hooks.ts already calls it so an open fight page cranks its own fight within seconds; useNudgeStatus exposes what the nudge last heard), /api/nudge, and in stocks.ts firstPriceAt, priceTimeAt, mixedHoursAt(a, b, now, round?, reader?) and nextFairTake. FightView already uses all of them. Build the redesigned fight screen ON them and preserve their behaviour exactly: (a) The status line and every countdown for ACCEPTED and LIVE-after-the-bell come from roundClock(d, now, nudge).line and .secondsLeft. Item 6 above (fightClock.pricesFrom stepping pricedAt every 15 minutes) is REPLACED: do not re-derive price times; 'Prices from' is priceClock/roundClock's time. A small fightClock.ts is fine only as a thin formatter over them, with tests. (b) The manual 'post the prices yourself' start and settle buttons appear ONLY when roundClock(...).manual says so (180 s after the price could exist), as a clearly secondary fallback, with the explanation line FightView uses today. Never at startDue or settleDue. No text claiming the settler 'normally does this within a minute'. (c) The take gate stays: mixedHoursAt(t1, t2, now, d, 'taker') disables Take with its sentence, and the click handler checks again with Date.now() before sending. The shut hints keep naming who prices each side (Pyth or the exchange) and when it reopens. (d) Waiting states use shutSides / waitingForMarket as exported today, not pricedAt(t, now). Read FightView.tsx as it is on main before you start; carry every one of these into Corner/PriceToBeat/Actions.
acceptance: npm run test:web passes (raceSeries, receipt, fightClock, koHealth); npm run build passes.
Settled fight 46tp...: META ticker readable, loser bar empty, green 'Took' plate, 'percentage points', an ET time range, receipt rows with explorer links.
Open challenge BiDS...: a live price per side, a closes-in countdown, a primary action that follows wallet state (connect, faucet, take), Tale of the tape visible.
Accepted fight 4yf7... while its market is shut: a countdown to prices, no 'Lock the start prices yourself' button.
Blocking /api/rpc in devtools shows 'Could not reach Solana', not 'No fight at this address'.
For a live round of 5 minutes or more, reloading the page restores the chart path from bars; a settled chart's endpoints equal the on-chain prices exactly.
No orange anywhere except the COOKED stamp; K.O. text is ink.
At 375px there is no horizontal scroll and the sticky answer bar never covers content.
The browser tab title updates during a live round; sound stays silent until toggled on.
An ACCEPTED fight shows no manual start button until roundClock(...).manual is true, and a LIVE fight past its bell shows no manual settle button until then.
The ACCEPTED and LIVE-after-the-bell status line is roundClock(...).line, and the countdown is roundClock(...).secondsLeft.
Take is disabled with mixedHoursAt's sentence for a mixed-hours pair, and the click re-checks before sending.
Opening a taken fight page in a visible tab still sends POST /api/nudge on the price clock's schedule (useDuel still calls useSettlerNudge).

title: Home as a live board: dense fight rows, the Wire, closing soon, last bell, proof strip
why:
The home page is the first impression, and the owner asked for pump.fun and fomo density. Today:
- Settled rows don't mark the winner.
- 'Rounds live now 0' has no context.
- Test-token and '?' fights fill the ring.
- The page is 467px wide on a 375px phone.
- The bottom half is marketing billboards.

Everything below comes from the duel list already polled.
spec: 1) src/app/page.tsx: keep TickerTape edge to edge and keep importing Movers and TickerTape unchanged (P9 owns them). Header row: h1.h-page 'Your stock vs theirs. ' plus 'Winner takes both.' in text-up; one meta dim line: 'Stake tokenized shares against someone else's. Bigger percentage move by the bell takes both stakes, paid in shares.'; Pick a fight btn-p1. Then SiteTally, then ClosingSoon. Then the grid: xl grid-cols-[minmax(0,5fr)_minmax(0,4fr)_minmax(0,3fr)] holding Ring (SectionHead 'In the ring' with link to All fights, LiveBoard), Wire, and a rail (SectionHead 'Moving today' plus Movers in a Plate std; SectionHead 'Who cooks' plus TopFighters in a Plate std); lg grid-cols-[minmax(0,7fr)_minmax(0,5fr)] with Ring and Wire stacked on the left; one column below lg in the order Ring, Wire, Moving today, Who cooks. Every grid child gets min-w-0. Delete the STEPS and TRUST sections and render ProofStrip plus one meta line 'Details and edge cases: ' with a .link to /how. No type at or above 48px anywhere on the page. 2) src/components/FightRow.tsx rewrite. Keep the exported names FightRow, waitingForMarket and statusLine and the props d, now, quotes; add an optional compact. Outer: Link to /f/ADDRESS with classes 'plate-card rope row block min-w-0' and dense padding. Line one (grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto_minmax(0,1fr)]): left is the P1 ticker (.display text-hud-sm text-p1) plus Move (.num text-sm); centre is the status Badge plus age; right is Move plus the P2 ticker (text-p2). Line two (meta, truncate): FighterName(creator, sm, href null inside the link) · shares with the token symbol in normal-case on the left; the centre shows '$25 a side' from stakeValue when priced; the right shows FighterName(opponent) or 'Open seat' or 'For ' plus a short invitee. Status: LIVE gives Badge live plus a Countdown (num size) to endTs; OPEN gives a Badge neutral with the round length (span) or 'to the bell', plus 'closes ' + until(expiresTs); ACCEPTED gives 'waiting for the open' or 'locking prices'; SETTLED gives 'Final · ' + ago(endTs); a tie gives 'Dead heat'; VOID gives 'Void'. Settled: the winning side shows Badge win 'W' and 'took $6.48' in text-up (derive.loserTake), and the loser's ticker gets opacity-50 plus .stamp-cooked-sm 'Cooked'. Open rows add a third meta line with the taunt in italics, truncated, and a 'Take' btn-sm btn-p2 chip (a span styled as a button; the whole row is the link). Below 640px: the P1 ticker and its move on one line (move right-aligned), the P2 ticker and its move on the next, then status and stake; nothing wider than its container. Rows are 64px tall on desktop and never taller than 96px on phones. 3) LiveBoard: filter with derive.isRosterFight; order live by endTs ascending, then accepted, then open by createdTs descending, then fill up to the limit with settled or tied fights by endTs descending. SkeletonRows kind fight while loading. Notice error 'Could not reach Solana.' with Retry calling refetch (never String(error)). When there is nothing active but settled fights exist, show them (no 'ring is empty' copy); Empty only when no roster fight has ever existed. When non-roster fights exist, add a micro dim footer: `${n} fights on devnet test tokens hidden` linking /fights?tab=final&test=1. 4) SiteTally as a ui/StatStrip with 7 cells: 'Tokenized stocks' ROSTER.length; 'Fight 24/7' AROUND_THE_CLOCK in ink; live > 0 gives 'Rounds live' with a LiveDot, otherwise 'Last bell' with ago(derive.lastBell(all)) (or '--' if 0); 'Open challenges'; 'Fights settled' (tallyOf, all on chain); 'Taken off losers' usd; 'Wallets with a result' (tallyOf fighters). No text-up anywhere; values in ink; no empty cell at any breakpoint. 5) New Wire.tsx: SectionHead 'The wire'. derive.fightEvents(duels, now) for roster fights, newest 12, inside a Plate. 36px rows linking /f/ADDRESS: ago() in a fixed-width micro dim column; a 14px glyph plate per kind; the sentence. opened: 'NVDA vs AAPL opened · 0.11 NVDAx on the table' with the taunt truncated after it. taken: FighterName(opponent) plus ' took it'. live: 'Round live: NVDA vs AAPL'. bell: 'AAPL cooked NVDA by 0.29 pts · took $25.00' with 'took ...' in text-up. heat: 'NVDA vs AAPL: dead heat. Both stakes home.'. void: 'NVDA vs AAPL voided. Both stakes home.'. expired: 'NVDA vs AAPL expired untaken.'. Tickers are always in their side colours. Keep seen event ids in a ref; events that are new on a later poll get .row-new once, never on first render. Empty only when there are zero events: 'Nothing on the wire yet.' with a Pick a fight action. 6) New ClosingSoon.tsx: up to 4 compact rope Plates in a row (overflow-x auto with snap inside its own container on phones; grid-cols-4 at lg): live roster rounds by endTs ascending with a Countdown and both Moves; open roster challenges by expiresTs ascending with until(expiresTs) and a Take chip linking /f/ADDRESS. No admin withdraw.', linking /how.
acceptance: npm run build and npm run test:web pass; FightView and FightsBoard still compile against FightRow's exports.
At 375px, document.documentElement.scrollWidth is 375 on / and the page is not zoomed out.
At 1440x900 the first viewport shows the tape, the stats strip, at least 6 fight rows, the Wire and Moving today.
Settled rows mark the winner with a green W and 'took $X'; the loser carries the mini COOKED stamp; no row covers a ticker.
No ETHt, SOLt, BTCt or '?' rows on home, and the hidden count is shown when there are any.
When no round is live, the stats strip shows 'Last bell' with a real age.
The STEPS and TRUST billboards are gone; no text-cooked outside a stamp; no cyan or pink on non-side elements.
A new event arriving between polls tints its Wire row once.

title: Fight ticket on /new: 24/7 defaults, win preview, sticky next-step button
why:
The create flow is the core loop, and today:
- The main button is about 2,600px down.
- A weekend visitor opens on TSLA (a stock that waits for the market) with an orange warning.
- Nothing says what you win.
- Pickers scroll inside the page.
- Token symbols are uppercased.
- Rematch links can't carry the opponent.
spec: 1) New pure src/lib/ticket.ts: defaultPair(nowSec) returns the first two STAKEABLE tickers where tradesAroundTheClock is true when session(nowSec*1000) is 'closed' (fall back to the first two STAKEABLE); otherwise ['TSLA', 'NVDA'] when both are stakeable, else the first two STAKEABLE. winPreview(amount1, amount2, t1, t2, q2) returns {keep: shares(amount1) + ' ' + tokenSymbol(t1), take: shares(amount2) + ' ' + tokenSymbol(t2), takeUsd: stakeValue(amount2, STAKE_DECIMALS, q2)}. roundChoices(nowSec) returns chips [{id: '5m', label: '5 min', sub: 'after a taker'}, {id: '15m', label: '15 min', sub: 'after a taker'}, {id: '1h', label: '1 hour', sub: 'after a taker'}, {id: 'bell', label: 'Next bell', sub: etTime(nextBell)}, {id: 'week', label: 'Friday bell', sub: etTime(weekBell)}]. ctaStep({connected, hasAccount, short, ready}) returns 'connect'|'faucet'|'stake'|'wait'. tests-web/ticket.test.ts covers the weekend default (both tickers 24/7), weekday default, winPreview and ctaStep. 2) CreateFight.tsx: read the p1, p2, usd and invite params; invite pre-fills the invite field and opens its disclosure. When p1 or p2 is absent use defaultPair. PageHeader: eyebrow 'New fight', title 'Pick a fight', and one meta line only. At lg, a grid of minmax(0,7fr) and minmax(0,5fr). Left: ui/Tabs 'Your fighter' and 'Their fighter' (when active, the tab uses the side tint background and side colour text) choosing which corner the single StockPicker edits, and after a pick, focus moves to the other corner if it is still empty; TaleOfTheTape below. Right: FightTicket, sticky top-20. Below lg: tabs, picker, tape, ticket; plus, once both fighters are chosen, a fixed bottom bar at calc(var(--bottom-nav-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) with rope, 'AAPL vs NVDA · $25 a side · 15 min' and the same primary action, with page padding reserved. Keep the buildCreateDuel, expiresTs and send logic unchanged; route to /f/ADDRESS?new=1 on success. 3) FightTicket.tsx in a Plate notch rope pad std: Versus of the two sides (ticker .display text-hud-lg in the side colour, name meta dim, shares plus token symbol in normal-case, and '$25.00 at $331.20' in .num). Stake chips ($5, $10, $25, $50, $100 as btn-sm, btn-light when selected) plus a custom dollar input. Round chips from roundChoices with the sub line under each label. Session notice as ui/Notice: info when the fight runs now, naming the perp or pool sides (the existing wording, in ink); warn when a side waits, with a button 'Use two 24/7 stocks' that applies defaultPair. Taunt input with an 'N/80 · written on chain' counter. A details disclosure 'Call someone out' with placeholder 'Their wallet address' and helper 'Only that wallet can take it.'. Win line: 'If you win: your ' + keep + ' back plus their ' + take + ' (worth ' + usd(takeUsd) + ' now)'. Price source line in meta dim. title: /fights board: URL tabs, called-out inbox, filters, dense dated list
why: The Fights nav link lands on one card at a third of the page width. 16 of 25 finals are test-token pairs. There is no sorting, no dates and no URL state, and the tabs are an inaccessible pink underline. This package uses the dense FightRow from P6 and the calledOut derivation from P3.
spec: 1) PageHeader: eyebrow 'On chain', title 'Fights', stats inline (live count with LiveDot, open count, settled count), action Pick a fight btn-p1. 2) ui/Tabs via useUrlTab('tab') with counts: Live (LIVE plus ACCEPTED), Open (unexpired OPEN), Final (SETTLED, REFUNDED, VOID), Mine (shown when connected), Called out (derive.calledOut for the connected wallet, shown when connected). Default: Live if it has any, else Open if any, else Final. 3) Query filters: w=WALLET keeps fights where the wallet is creator or opponent and shows a removable chip 'Fighter: ' plus FighterName sm and a remove button; t=TICKER keeps fights with that ticker on either side and shows a removable chip; test=1 includes non-roster fights; otherwise non-roster fights are hidden and a text button 'Show N test-token fights' sets test=1. All filters persist in the URL. 4) One single-column list inside a Plate: FightRow for each fight. Sort: Live by endTs ascending (accepted after live), Open by createdTs descending, Final by endTs descending, Mine and Called out by the most recent of createdTs, acceptedTs and endTs. On Final, insert a micro dim date divider row per ET day ('Sat 12 Sep'). Render 30 rows, then a 'Show 30 more' button. Prices: usePrices only for OPEN and LIVE rows on screen (max 60 tickers). 5) States: SkeletonRows fight while loading; Notice error 'Could not reach Solana.' with Retry; per-tab Empty: Live 'Nothing live right now.' with a link to Open; Open 'No open challenges.' with Pick a fight; Final 'No settled fights yet.'; Mine not connected gives 'Connect to see your fights.' with a button calling requestConnect(); Called out 'Nobody has called you out.'. 6) src/app/fights/page.tsx wraps FightsBoard in Suspense with a SkeletonRows fallback (needed for useSearchParams).
acceptance: npm run build passes.
Refreshing /fights?tab=final&w=<wallet> keeps the tab and the fighter filter.
Final shows a count and ET date dividers, newest first.
Test-token and '?' fights are hidden by default with a visible count and a toggle.
At 375px there is no horizontal scroll and the answerer's ticker is visible on every row.
Tabs expose role tablist and aria-selected, and arrow keys move between them; no pink underline remains.

title: Stock pages, sparkline movers and an accessible tape
why: fomo and pump.fun give every asset a page. Stonk Wars has 1,033 tokenized stocks and no page for any of them. The tape and Movers also hand-roll toFixed (so '-0.00%' can appear), put stock colour squares (red, lime) next to price moves, tag 24/7 in green, and the tape hides focusable links from screen readers.
spec: 1) src/app/s/[ticker]/page.tsx: server component. byTicker(params.ticker.toUpperCase()), else notFound(). generateMetadata title 'NVDA · NVIDIA Corporation'. Suspense fallback skeleton around StockView. 2) StockView.tsx (client): header Plate notch with the ticker in .display text-hud-lg in ink (a stock has no side until it is in a corner), name, kind, market, issuers joined by ' · '. Badges: session state words from session(); 'Priced by' with pricedAt(ticker, now) mapped to Exchange, Perp, Pool or 'Waits for the open'; neutral '24/7' when tradesAroundTheClock; source from sourceLabel. Live price in .num text-num-lg inside FlashNum price mode, day change via Move, and Badge source sourceWords(quote.source), from usePrices([ticker], 5000). Actions: 'Fight with it' btn-p1 to /new?p1=TICKER and 'Fight against it' btn-p2 to /new?p2=TICKER; when the ticker is not in STAKEABLE, hide them and show Notice info 'Not stakeable on devnet yet.'. 3) IntradayChart.tsx: GET /api/bars?t=TICKER&from=now-21600&to=now, refreshed every 60s. SVG single line (tone move from first to last), dashed previous-close line from quote.prev, ET hour ticks, pointer and touch crosshair with ET time and price. Caption 'Minute bars from the exchange, extended hours, and the perp when the exchange is shut. For watching.'. Show the response note when present, and Notice error on failure. 4) Fighter stats: useFighters([ticker]) for Power, Form and Room with ui/Tip explanations (same wording as TaleOfTheTape), plus a one-month Sparkline (tone move, width 160, height 40) from useCloses. 5) Record on chain: derive.tickerRecord(ticker, duels) as a StatStrip (fights, wins, losses, win rate). SectionHead 'Open challenges' lists open roster fights with this ticker using FightRow, with Empty 'No open challenges on NVDA.' and a Fight with it action. SectionHead 'Recent results' shows 5 settled fights with this ticker, linking 'All fights with NVDA' to /fights?t=TICKER&tab=final. 6) src/lib/useCloses.ts: useCloses(tickers) uses react-query over /api/stats?t= in batches of 8, staleTime 30 minutes, refetchOnWindowFocus false, returning Record<ticker, number[]>. 7) Movers.tsx: rows link to /s/TICKER. Use pct() for the change and FlashNum on price and change. Replace the stock colour square with a Sparkline (width 40, height 14, tone move) from useCloses. 24/7 as a neutral Badge on eligible rows and an equal-width spacer on the others so columns line up. Price and change in fixed-width right-aligned .num columns. SkeletonRows quote while loading; Notice 'Prices unavailable.' with Retry on error. 8) TickerTape.tsx: remove aria-hidden from the outer container and give it role region with aria-label 'Live prices'. The first copy of the run keeps normal links; the duplicate second copy is aria-hidden with tabIndex -1 on its links. Links go to /s/TICKER. Use pct() for the change and FlashNum on the change. 24/7 as a neutral micro Badge. Remove the stock colour square.
acceptance: npm run build passes.
/s/NVDA shows the live price with its source, the intraday chart, the month sparkline, the record and open challenges; /s/NOTREAL shows the 404 page.
Movers and the tape never print '-0.00%' and show no stock colour squares next to moves.
24/7 tags are neutral, not green.
Tabbing through the tape reaches each stock once; screen readers are not handed a hidden container full of links.
At 375px, /s/NVDA has no horizontal scroll.

title: How it works with a live worked example, legal alignment, palette sync and dead code
why: /how is 3,370px of prose with code names in the copy and a hand-typed 37. A worked example drawn from a real settled fight explains the game faster than any paragraph. The OG colour copy has drifted from the tokens, and dead code should not ship in a judged repo.
spec: 1) src/app/how/page.tsx: PageHeader (eyebrow 'The rules', title 'How it works'). At lg, a grid with a sticky table of contents on the left (anchor links to every question; the current section in ink, found with IntersectionObserver and no animation) and a centered max-w-[68ch] content column; on phones, a details element 'On this page' holding the same links. Open with a 3-cell rules strip (Plate dense cells: 'Call it', 'They answer', 'The bell decides', each a .label plus two text-sm lines reusing the home page's current step copy), then WorkedExample, then the FAQ with each question given an id slug. Replace the hardcoded '37' in the market-closed answer with AROUND_THE_CLOCK. Move developer detail (the previous < boundary <= rule, parsePriceFeedUpdatesUnique, bar close rules) into details elements titled 'For developers' so body copy has no code identifiers. Keep every rule's meaning unchanged. 2) New WorkedExample.tsx (client): from useDuels('all', allDuels()), pick the newest settled roster fight (derive.isRosterFight), preferring one whose two start-price stake values are within 5% of each other. Render in a Plate rope: 'NVDA vs META · ' + etWhen(startTs, endTs), then one line per side: ticker in its side colour, start to bell price and the pct() move from on-chain prices, then 'NVDA won by 0.0062 percentage points and took 0.0100 METAx.' using derive.margin and loserTake, then a link 'See the receipt' to /f/ADDRESS. Skeleton while loading; render nothing if no settled roster fight exists. 3) src/components/Legal.tsx: use PageHeader (h-page) and a centered max-w-[68ch] column matching /how; inline links use .link. Privacy and terms pages keep their content. 4) Delete src/components/SampleFight.tsx (never imported). In src/components/Ticker.tsx delete the unused TickerBadge and keep Move unchanged. 5) src/lib/palette.ts: add panel2, panel3, lineStrong, faint, p1Deep, p2Deep, p1Tint, p2Tint, upTint and downTint, matching globals.css. New tests-web/palette.test.ts reads src/app/globals.css with fs, parses every --color-NAME: #hex inside @theme, maps camelCase palette keys to kebab-case token names, and asserts each palette entry equals its token (case-insensitive).
acceptance: npm run test:web passes, including palette.test.ts, and the test fails if a palette hex is changed.
npm run build passes.
The first screen of /how shows the table of contents and rules strip, not prose; body copy has no code identifiers outside 'For developers'.
The worked example's numbers match the receipt of the fight it links to.

Searching the repo finds no import of SampleFight or TickerBadge.
